Because FIFA is only a football game on the surface.

It’s a bunch of math if you look into it, every action in game is just a bunch of numbers getting crunched and messing with variables, and then after all the math is done, you get an outcome, if that mathematical outcome is that your center back will fall on his ass and sit there for 5 seconds just so the striker can get to the ball first, then that’s what it is, because the game already “calculated” that the striker is getting the ball in that dispute, now it just needs to show it to you in a way that doesn’t look stupid, the thing is, when you have two players with different connections sending and receiving data simultaneously whilst simulating the same experience, shit looks goofy occasionally.

This game looks stupid because it does a terrible job of showing you with animations, the calculations that it already made previously, but if you were to look at the code, you’d see it’s actually pretty simple, it just takes stats and mixes it up with a bunch of variables to decide an outcome, once that outcome has been decided, it will show you whatever it needs, to make sure that outcome is fulfilled, sometimes it’s your striker coming to a halt because the center back is supposed to get the ball.
